title: selling.parse_price input
description: A typed price, total or rate per mg (SM-13, SM-D9; PRICE-1, PRICE-2).

text.description: A figure typed by a person: digits with at most one '.' or ',' as the decimal mark, nothing else, after trimming what both apps' trims remove (PRICE-2: tab, line breaks, spaces, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000..U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000; never U+001C..U+001F or U+FEFF).

max.description: The cap the exact typed value must be within: a unit's price ($10,000), a whole cart's total ($10,000,000) or a rate per mg ($1,000).
